bom.notes: Converts 19V DC from laptop adapter to regulated 14.0V DC for charging a 12V lead-acid battery. (e.g., LM2596 module, XL4015 module, Mini560 module)
Connecting adapter to converter and converter to alligator clips. (e.g., Speaker wire 18AWG, Hookup wire 18AWG)
Provide temporary clip-on connection to battery terminals. (e.g., Red/black alligator clips with insulated handles)
Provides 19V DC input to the step-down converter from mains power. (e.g., Dell 19.5V 3.34A, HP 19V 2.1A, Lenovo 20V 3.25A)

author: Steve Willson Kujur

name: How to Make 6-Pointed Paper Snowflakes
summary: A step-by-step crafting tutorial for folding and cutting paper into six-pointed snowflake decorations. Unlike common four- or eight-point designs, this method replicates the natural hexagonal symmetry of real snow crystals.
author: ReadsInTrees

name: How to Make a 12V Lithium-Ion Battery Pack at Home Using Old Laptop Cells
summary: Проект по сборке 12В литий-ионного аккумулятора из извлеченных 18650 ячеек старых ноутбучных батарей. Используется BMS 3S 10A для защиты. Цель — дать вторую жизнь отслужившим элементам для off-grid питания.

bom.notes: Набор ячеек для сборки 3S2P (3 последовательно, 2 параллельно) для получения номинального напряжения 11.1V и увеличенной емкости. (e.g., 18650 Li-ion 3.7V, Panasonic NCR18650B, Samsung 30Q)
Балансировка ячеек и защита от перезаряда (>4.25V/ячейку), переразряда (<2.5V/ячейку), короткого замыкания и перегрева. (e.g., 3S 10A BMS для Li-ion, 3S 12A BMS, 3S 15A BMS)
Соединение контактов ячеек методом точечной сварки. (e.g., Никелевая лента 0.15x8mm, Никелированная сталь 0.2x8mm)
Силовые провода для подключения нагрузки (до 10A) к BMS. (e.g., Silicon wire 14 AWG, PVC wire 14 AWG)
Фиксация ячеек в правильном положении для сварки и предотвращение коротких замыканий. (e.g., 3D printed cell holder for 6x 18650, Custom STL from Thingiverse)
Разъем для подключения к нагрузке (инвертору, светильнику). (e.g., XT60 connector, Deans T-connector, SAE connector)

author: ER GREAT

name: How To: Make a Bath Bomb
summary: В этом проекте показано, как вручную изготовить ароматические шипучие бомбочки для ванны из бикарбоната натрия, лимонной кислоты и эфирных масел. Процесс включает смешивание сухих ингредиентов, добавление влаги и отдушек, формовку и сушку. Проект не имеет отношения к электронике или выживанию, а является косметическим подарком.

bom.notes: основной шипучий агент, реагирует с кислотой (e.g., sodium_bicarbonate_food_grade)
кислотный компонент для реакции шипения в воде (e.g., citric_acid_food_grade)
ароматизация бомбочки (e.g., lavender_essential_oil, citrus_essential_oil)
гомогенизация аромата, питание кожи (e.g., sweet_almond_oil, jojoba_oil, olive_oil)
окраска бомбочки (e.g., liquid_food_colouring, cosmetic_soap_colour_powder)
активация влажности для формовки (e.g., cold_tap_water)

author: Louisa Jennings Art

name: Foldable Pikler Triangle (Climbing Frame)
summary: Детский спортивный комплекс в виде складной пирамиды-треугольника для лазания. Развивает моторику и координацию ребенка по методике Эмми Пиклер. Изготовлен из дерева, складывается для хранения.

bom.notes: Основной несущий каркас — две длинные боковины (стойки) и две короткие (для поворотного узла). Воспринимает нагрузки от веса ребенка. (e.g., Douglas Fir 2x3x12ft, Pine 2x3x12ft)
Перекладины для лазания, воспринимают нагрузку ног и рук ребенка. Должны плотно сидеть в гнездах, без люфта. (e.g., Birch dowel 1" x 36", Oak dowel 1" x 36")
Фиксация поворотного узла к стойкам. Обеспечивает шарнирное соединение для складывания. (e.g., Deck screw #8 x 2", Drywall screw 2" coarse)
Защита древесины от влаги, грязи и механического износа. Без покрытия дерево трескается и занозит. (e.g., Minwax Polyurethane satin water-based, Rust-Oleum Marine Spar Varnish)

author: statestraveller

name: How to Make a Cootie Catcher
summary: This is a paper craft project to fold a traditional cootie catcher (fortune teller) toy from a single sheet of paper. It involves precise folding, cutting, and decorating with colors and fortunes for play. The project requires only common office/school supplies.

bom.notes: Structural material for the paper toy (e.g., standard 80 gsm printer paper)
Color coding the 4 outer sections for the game mechanic (e.g., Crayola markers, Staedtler markers)
Writing numbers and fortunes clearly (e.g., black Sharpie, black ballpoint pen)
Cutting the paper to form a perfect square (e.g., standard household scissors)
Creating consistent circles for the color sections (e.g., coin (US quarter), bottle cap, jar lid)

author: BrittneyWhiting

name: How to Make a Fishtail Braid
summary: An instructable demonstrating how to create a fishtail braid hairstyle using only hair and an elastic band. The process involves dividing hair into two sections and repeatedly crossing small outer strands to the opposite side.
author: ecbecbecb

name: Floating Wine Bottle Holder
summary: This project demonstrates the principle of center of gravity by creating a wooden board that, when a wine bottle is inserted, appears to float in the air. It involves cutting and finishing a hardwood board at a precise angle to achieve balance.

bom.notes: Structural base that holds the wine bottle and acts as the counterweight. (e.g., 15x3.125x0.75_inch_oak_board)
Provides the weight and center of gravity for the balancing act. (e.g., Standard 750ml wine bottle)

author: craftknowitall

name: How to Make a Fold Out Sofa/Futon/Bed Frame
summary: This project provides step-by-step instructions to build a wooden tri-fold futon frame that can be used as a sofa or a bed. It is a carpentry project that uses basic hand tools and hardware such as screws, bolts, and washers, with custom-cut wooden planks for the frame and hinges.

bom.notes: Main structural planks forming the sofa/bed frame sections (e.g., Pine plank 48"x3.5"x0.75")
Vertical support struts for the middle section hinge points (e.g., Pine plank 30"x2.75"x0.75")
Vertical support struts for the foot section hinge points (e.g., Pine plank 27.5"x2.75"x0.75")
Vertical support struts for the head section hinge points (e.g., Pine plank 27"x2.75"x0.75")
Fasten small planks to large planks (approx. 5 per joint) (e.g., 4mm wood screw 30mm length)
Hinge bolts allowing sections to fold flat (e.g., 6mm hex bolt 40mm with wing nut)
Strengthen joints and prevent wood splitting (e.g., PVA wood glue)
Wood finish for moisture protection and appearance (e.g., Teak oil 250ml)

author: VVBoredGuy

name: Fractal Antenna for HDTV / DTV on the Cheap
summary: DIY construction of a fractal antenna for receiving over-the-air HDTV/DTV signals using simple tools and materials. The project replaces expensive store-bought antennas with a homemade design based on iterated fractal shapes, offering a low-cost solution for free TV reception in off-grid or suburban settings.

bom.notes: Each wire is bent into a fractal pattern (series of equilateral triangles) to form the radiating/conducting elements of the antenna. Four elements create a quad fractal dipole array. (e.g., 18 AWG solid copper wire, telephone wire solid core)

Matches the balanced 300-ohm impedance of the fractal dipole array to the unbalanced 75-ohm coaxial cable input of the TV/DTV receiver. Necessary for maximum power transfer. (e.g., Balun 75-to-300 ohm transformer, TV antenna matching transformer)
Placed behind the fractal elements to reflect radio waves forward, increasing gain and directivity. Acts as a ground plane. (e.g., Steel or aluminum sheet, metal mesh screen)

Screws serve as mounting posts and electrical connection points for the fractal wires and transformer. Four corner screws hold fractals; two center screws connect transformer. (e.g., #6 sheet metal screws, brass screws, steel wood screws)
Provides structural support and protection for the antenna assembly. The reflector is installed under the plastic cover. (e.g., Plastic junction box, wood frame, plastic project box)

author: williamruckman

name: How to Make a Garden Fountain Out Of, Well, Anything You Want
summary: Проект строительства декоративного садового фонтана с циркуляцией воды. Основная идея — использование любого понравившегося материала (камней, керамики, металла) в качестве скульптуры, через которую переливается вода, подаваемая насосом из скрытого бассейна. Проект ориентирован на ландшафтный дизайн, а не на электронику или пайку.

bom.notes: Циркуляция воды: забор из бассейна и подача наверх через медную трубу. (e.g., Aquascape 800 GPH, TetraPond 250 GPH submersible pump)
Резервуар для воды (скрытый бассейн) объемом 60-80 литров. (e.g., Rubbermaid 18-gallon Roughneck tote, Sterilite 20-gallon storage bin)
Вертикальный водовод: вода поднимается внутри трубы от насоса к верхнему камню. (e.g., 1/2-inch Type M copper pipe, 3 ft length)
Регулировка потока воды (отсечной кран) и возможность отключения насоса без слива. (e.g., SharkBite 1/2-inch brass ball valve with compression ends)
Защита силового кабеля: траншея от бассейна к розетке. (e.g., Schedule 40 PVC conduit, 1 inch diameter)
Настил, скрывающий бассейн и экран, на который укладываются камни. (e.g., Pressure-treated pine deck board 2x6x12 ft)
Скульптура фонтана: вода переливается через камни, создавая декоративный эффект. (e.g., River rocks 4-10 inches diameter, Flagstone fragments)
Фиксация камней друг к другу для устойчивости. (e.g., GE Silicone II Clear Window & Door, DAP 100% Silicone)

author: This Old House

name: How to Make a Go-Kart
summary: A step-by-step guide to building a functional go-kart from scratch using steel tubing, a used engine, and basic fabrication skills. Covers frame jig construction, welding, axle assembly, steering system, and engine mounting with torque converter.

bom.notes: Primary structural chassis in feet; forms perimeter frame and crossmembers (e.g., A513 steel tube 1.25x1.25x0.065 inch, HREW 1.25 inch square tube)
Rear axle transmits torque from engine to wheels; supports vehicle weight (e.g., Cold-rolled steel rod 3/4 inch diameter, Metric 20mm shaft)
Supports rear axle and steering shaft with low friction rotation (e.g., UCF204-12 pillow block, FY20M bearing unit)
Provides propulsion via 6.5 hp at 3600 RPM; single-cylinder 4-stroke (e.g., Predator 212cc 6.5hp, Honda GX200 clone)
CVT transmission provides variable ratio from 2.7:1 to 0.9:1; eliminates clutch (e.g., Go-kart 30 series torque converter, Comet TAV2 clone)
Transfers engine power from torque converter output to rear axle (e.g., #35 chain 80 links, 60-tooth axle sprocket, 12-tooth engine sprocket)
Provides stopping power via hydraulic pressure on ventilated rotor (e.g., Hydraulic disc brake caliper for go-kart, Wilwood M-series clone)
Connects steering shaft to spindles via tie rods; allows articulation without slop (e.g., QM5-16T heim joint, Male threaded rod end 5/16-24)
Provides traction and flotation; rear should be wider for stability (e.g., 10x4.5-5 turf saver tire + rim, 10 inch go-kart tire on steel wheel)
Supports driver with seat belt mounts and lateral support (e.g., Plastic bucket seat with 4-bolt pattern, Universal fiberglass racing seat)

author: thegokartguy

name: How to Make a Green Lantern Ring - Including a Glowing Version!
summary: This project shows how to create a Green Lantern ring using two different methods: one is a resin-cast translucent ring with an embedded green LED for a glowing effect, and the other is a more durable cast sterling silver version. The guide covers creating a master wax pattern, making a silicone RTV mold, resin casting, and basic silversmithing techniques.

bom.notes: Illuminates the green lantern symbol (e.g., 5mm green LED, 1.8V)
Powers the LED (e.g., CR1220 3V lithium coin cell)
Holds the coin cell securely and provides electrical contact (e.g., CR1220 button cell holder/battery retainer (SMD or through-hole))
Forms the translucent green ring body for the glowing version (e.g., Smooth Cast 325 (15 oz), EasyFlo 120)

author: Honus

name: How to Make a Knife
summary: Подробное руководство по изготовлению цельнометаллического ножа с деревянной рукояткой и латунными больстерами с нуля. Проект требует навыков работы с металлом, термической обработки стали и столярных работ.

bom.notes: Основа клинка ножа — режущая часть (e.g., 01 Carbon Steel sheet 4mm, 1095 high carbon steel, 80CrV2 steel)
Формирует рукоятку ножа (e.g., Walnut handle scales, Padauk, Cocobolo)
Укрепляет переход между клинком и рукоятью, добавляет вес и эстетику (e.g., Brass block 10x20x30mm)
Клепка для больстеров (фиксация к клинку) (e.g., 4mm brass bar, 100mm length)
Сплошные заклепки для крепления деревянных плашек рукояти (e.g., Corby Rivets 2 pcs for handle)
Финишная обработка клинка, больстеров и рукояти (e.g., Sandpaper assortment from 80 to 3000 grit)
Пропитка и защита деревянной рукояти от влаги (e.g., CCL Wood Finishing Oil 250ml, Mineral oil, Tung oil)

author: Phil Reilly

name: How to Make a Metal Rose
summary: This project creates a decorative metal rose from scrap steel or other ferrous metal. It involves cutting three circles, marking and cutting petals, cleaning edges, welding the petals onto a metal rod stem, and heating and shaping the petals with a torch. The result is a durable, artistic flower suitable for gifts or decoration.

bom.notes: Petals of the rose, cut into circles then petal shapes (e.g., scrap steel sheet, mild steel plate, car body panel)
Stem of the rose (e.g., steel rod, rebar, thick wire)
Welding petals to stem (e.g., 6013 2.5mm mild steel electrode)

author: Downard Works

name: Miniature Tesla Coil
summary: A simple, battery-powered miniature Tesla coil that generates high-voltage, low-current arcs using a 2N2222A transistor oscillator. This project demonstrates resonant transformer principles and produces small sparks suitable for educational demonstrations.

bom.notes: Oscillator transistor — drives the resonant primary coil with pulsed DC from the 9V battery (e.g., 2N2222A, PN2222A, BC548)
Base bias resistor for the 2N2222A transistor — limits base current to ~0.4mA with 9V supply (e.g., 22kΩ 0.25W carbon film)
Snubber capacitor across the primary coil — suppresses back-EMF spikes and improves oscillation stability (e.g., 0.01µF 50V ceramic disc)
Power source — provides 9V DC to oscillator circuit (e.g., 9V alkaline (Duracell MN1604), 9V NiMH rechargeable)
Primary coil winding — ~10 meters for 350 turns on 2cm PVC former (e.g., 28 AWG (0.32mm) enameled copper wire, 30 AWG (0.25mm))
Secondary coil winding — ~30cm for 4-5 turns (e.g., 22 AWG (0.64mm) enameled copper wire)
Coil former — provides mechanical structure for winding (e.g., 2cm OD x 9cm PVC pipe (standard electrical conduit))
On/off control for the circuit (e.g., Miniature toggle switch SPST, Slide switch)
Battery connection (e.g., 9V battery snap connector with 15cm leads)

author: JunezRiyaz

name: How to Make a Negative Ion Air Ionizer
summary: Проект создания отрицательного ионного ионизатора воздуха для очистки и освежения воздуха в помещении. Представлены две схемы: полно-волновая и полу-волновая, с опциональным вентилятором для полно-волновой версии. Основа устройства — умножитель напряжения на диодах 1N4007 и конденсаторах 275V, создающий высокое напряжение для ионизации на углеродном волокне (CF).

bom.notes: Умножение напряжения + создание постоянного отрицательного напряжения высоковольтного каскада. Диоды работают в паре с конденсаторами как каскады удвоения/умножения по схеме Кокрофта-Уолтона. (e.g., 1N4007, 1N4007G, 1N4007-TP)

Накопитель энергии в каждой ступени множителя напряжения. Работают последовательно, выдерживая общее напряжение до 3000V. Класс X2 обеспечивает самовосстановление при пробое. (e.g., B32921C3104M, MKP-X2 0.1uF 275V, ECQU2A104ML)
Ограничение выходного тока для безопасности. Снижает ток утечки на иглы до безопасного уровня (единицы мА при HV). (e.g., CFR100J10M, MF0207FTE10M0)
Обдув HV-игл для увеличения дальности распространения ионов в помещении. Увеличивает эффективность очистки воздуха. (e.g., Sunon MB60201V1-000U-A99, ADDA AD0605HB-G70)
Не используется в данном проекте — управление напрямую от сети 230V. Упоминается для контекста. (e.g., IRLZ44N, IRLZ34N, IRFZ44N)
Не используется в проекте. (e.g., NEMA17 HS4401, 17HS19-2004S1)

author: petercd

name: How to Make a PIP-Boy (Prototype)
summary: This project details the construction of a wearable PIP-Boy prop based on the Fallout video game series. It covers the hardware selection, circuit assembly, laser-cut case fabrication, and software programming for a functional, retro-futuristic wrist-mounted computer.

bom.notes: Main controller running the PIP-Boy firmware; reads sensors, drives LCD, handles user input. (e.g., Arduino Pro Mini 5V 16MHz)
Primary display showing time, compass, radiation readout, and system menus. (e.g., Nokia 5110 LCD (84x48 pixels))
Stores firmware assets (graphics, sounds) and user data logs. (e.g., MicroSD breakout board (SPI))
Main navigation input: rotate for scroll, push to select menu items. (e.g., ALPS EC11 rotary encoder with switch)
UP and DOWN buttons for quick menu navigation without rotary encoder. (e.g., 6x6x5mm tactile push button)
Provides regulated 3.3V supply for LCD, SD card, and encoder logic from 5V bus. (e.g., AMS1117-3.3, LM1117-3.3)
Steps up single-cell LiPo voltage (3.7V nominal) to stable 5V for Arduino and LCD backlight. (e.g., MT3608 boost module, Pololu 5V step-up)
Portable power source; single-cell 3.7V 2000mAh LiPo providing ~3-4 hours runtime. (e.g., 2S 7.4V 2000mAh LiPo (two cells)? No, single-cell 3.7V 2000mAh)
Manages safe charging of 3.7V LiPo battery via 5V USB input with CC/CV algorithm. (e.g., TP4056 micro-USB charging board)
Decoupling capacitors on VCC (3.3V), VIN (5V), and 3.3V regulator input. (e.g., 10µF 16V X5R 0805)
Input and output filter capacitors for 5V boost regulator (≥100µF each). (e.g., 100µF 10V radial electrolytic)
Current limiter for LCD backlight LED (Anode to D7 pin). (e.g., 330Ω 1/8W carbon film)
Current limiter for piezo buzzer (series between D12 and buzzer +). (e.g., 100Ω 1/8W carbon film)
Pull-up resistors for rotary encoder switch, CLK, and DT pins. (e.g., 10kΩ 1/4W carbon film)
Generates audio feedback on button presses and notifications. (e.g., 9x5mm piezo buzzer element)

author: Aleator777

name: How to Make a Portable Game System
summary: Пошаговое руководство по созданию портативной версии Nintendo Entertainment System (NES) из оригинальной консоли, PSone экрана и аккумуляторов. Проект включает разборку консоли, удаление RF-блока, установку картриджного разъема, пайку видеоусилителя (2N4401 + резисторы 33/220 Ом), сборку регулятора питания на 7805, LED-модификацию подсветки экрана, изготовление контроллера на основе 4021 сдвигового регистра и корпуса из оргстекла.

bom.notes: Основной процессор консоли NES (RP2A03@1.79MHz) и PPU для графики. (e.g., NES motherboard (RP2A03G CPU, RP2C02G PPU))
Стабилизация 7.2V-9V батареи в 5V для питания NES платы. (e.g., 7805 (в корпусе TO-220))
Дополнительный стабилизатор для PSone экрана (если батарея >9V, настроить на 8V). (e.g., 7805 (в корпусе TO-220))
Усиление видеосигнала композитного выхода NES (после удаления RF-блока). (e.g., 2N4401)
Защита от обратной полярности на входе 7805 регулятора. (e.g., 1N4001)
Считывание состояния 8 кнопок контроллера (D-pad 4 + A/B + Start/Select). (e.g., CD4021BE (DIP-16))
8x 47kΩ — подтяжка кнопок контроллера; 33Ω + 220Ω — цепь видеоусилителя; 20Ω — ограничение тока LED подсветки. (e.g., 47kΩ (1/4W), 33Ω (1/4W), 220Ω (1/4W))
Фильтрация пульсаций на входе 7805 регулятора. (e.g., 1000µF 16V)
Подавление высокочастотных помех на входе и выходе 7805. (e.g., 0.1µF 50V)
Фильтрация выходного напряжения 7805 (дополнительно к 0.1µF). (e.g., 10µF 16V (керамический))
Дисплей 5.4" 320×240 с композитным (NTSC) входом и встроенным стереоусилителем. (e.g., PSone LCD (LC-64BR11, модельный номер SCPH-105))
Замена CCFL подсветки PSone экрана на LED (белый, диффузный). (e.g., 3mm white LED)
Кнопки D-pad (4), A/B (2), Start/Select (2) для управления играми. (e.g., Tact switch 6×6×5mm, 4-pin)
Питание 7.2V для NES платы и PSone экрана (через 7805). (e.g., NiMH RC pack 7.2V 3000mAh, 7 клеток)
Зарядка Li-ion (если выбраны) через Micro-USB порт. (e.g., TP4056 литий-ионный зарядный модуль)
Замена оригинального разъема NES для подключения картриджей (делает консоль компактнее). (e.g., 72-pin 0.1" pitch card-edge connector)
Монтаж контроллера (4021 + резисторы + тактовые свитчи). (e.g., Perfboard 5×7см)
Сборка корпуса портативной консоли. (e.g., Оргстекло 5мм, листы 30×20см)
Выключатель питания: отключает батарею от всей схемы. (e.g., DPST toggle switch, 2A@12V)
Вывод A/V (композитное видео + аудио L/R) на внешний дисплей. (e.g., RCA jack 3.5мм TRS (стерео + видео))

author: 1up

name: How to Make a Professional Printed Circuit Board: the Complete Guide
summary: A complete guide to fabricating professional-quality PCBs at home using photolithography and chemical etching. Learn how to transfer a circuit design onto a presensitized copper board, develop, etch, tin, and drill it.

bom.notes: To expose presensitized board to UV light for transferring the artwork (e.g., DIY UV box (UV LEDs or fluorescent tubes))
Base material that holds copper traces after etching (e.g., MG Chemicals 30-001 (single-sided), Bungard R-1)
To print the PCB artwork for UV exposure (e.g., Inkjet transparency sheets, Laser printer transparency)
To chemically dissolve unwanted copper from the board (e.g., MG Chemicals 415-01, HCl + H2O2 alternative)
To develop the exposed photoresist pattern (e.g., NaOH pellets (lye) 98%)
To remove the hardened photoresist after etching (e.g., Technical grade acetone from hardware store)

author: Joebarteam

name: iPhone Projector from a Shoebox
summary: A low-cost DIY projector for iPhone/iPod using a cardboard box and a magnifying glass lens. The device works by placing the phone in a homemade stand inside a lightproof box, with the screen light projecting through the magnifying glass onto a wall. The entire project costs approximately $1 and takes 15-20 minutes to assemble.

bom.notes: Primary lens to project and magnify iPhone/iPod screen image onto a wall (e.g., Any focal length >50mm magnifying glass, Handheld reading magnifier)
Enclosure that blocks all external light, creating a dark projection chamber (e.g., Standard shoebox (approx 30x20x15 cm), Any sturdy cardboard box with lid)
Sealing light leaks in the box and securing the lens in place (e.g., Standard grey duct tape 48mm x 50m)
Holds iPhone/iPod vertically at the correct distance from the lens (e.g., LEGO bricks + base plate, Play-Doh modeling clay)

author: MattBothell

name: How to Make a Propane Forge
summary: A high-efficiency propane forge built from a portable air tank, lined with ceramic fiber blanket (kaowool) and refractory coating. Designed for blacksmithing, knife-making, and heat-treating metal up to forging temperatures. Includes a removable front opening and a rear exhaust port for long workpieces.

bom.notes: Provides mixing of propane and air for combustion inside forge chamber (e.g., Ron Reil side-arm burner, David Hammer forged burner, commercial Whisper Burner)
Thermal insulation lining the forge chamber walls (e.g., Kaowool 1-inch thick, Fiberfrax Durablanket)
Removable front door and rear wall with exhaust port (e.g., Kaowool M board, McMaster-Carr 93315K11)
Stabilizes ceramic fibers and reflects heat back into the forge (e.g., ITC-100 HT, Mizzou castable refractory)
Floor material that withstands flux and abrasion during forging (e.g., McMaster-Carr 8463K11, Porter Warner H-25)
Forge body container (e.g., DeWalt 6-gal portable air tank, Husky 4-gal)
Mounting tube for burner; welded to tank (e.g., Schedule 40 black iron 1-inch NPT x 4-inch)

author: AndrewW1977

name: How to Make a Proper Western Union Solder Joint
summary: A step-by-step guide to creating a Western Union solder joint, a classic 100-year-old technique from the telegraph era. This joint is known for its mechanical strength and reliability, making it ideal for off-grid and survival scenarios where solder joints must withstand vibration and tension without failure.

bom.notes: Основа для формирования механически прочного проводного соединения методом Western Union. (e.g., AWG22 stranded copper wire, 2-core)
Формирование токопроводящего моста и фиксация спиральной обмотки. (e.g., 60/40 tin-lead rosin-core solder, lead-free SAC305)
Улучшение смачиваемости жил и окисленного слоя. (e.g., rosin flux pen, paste flux)
Изоляция готового спая от воды и механических повреждений. (e.g., polyolefin heat shrink 2:1, diameter 3mm)

author: izzyspeaks123

name: How to Make a Racing Lawn Mower (Updated!)
summary: Detailed guide on converting a standard riding lawn mower into a competitive racing mower capable of 50+ MPH on dirt tracks. Covers frame reinforcement, steering geometry, drivetrain upgrades, engine building (porting, piston, cam), and safety systems including brakes and a 'puke tank' for the engine.

bom.notes: Main power source; gasoline combustion provides ~6-8hp after governor removal and porting (e.g., Briggs & Stratton 14.5 OHV (early 90s model), Briggs 12.5 flathead with cast iron sleeve)

Replaces OEM flywheel that fails at high rpm (spall fragment); billet withstands 8000+ rpm; high torque starter needed for compression (e.g., ARC Racing 6246 billet flywheel, ARC 6280 high torque starter)
Provides precise steering input; 3:1 ratio with drop pitman arm (e.g., Honda Civic 51010-S84-A01 (manual rack), Mitsubishi Mirage 51010-M8000)
Rear axle transmits engine power through chain; 1in thick for torque at 50mph; sprocket 60T (e.g., 1in solid steel axle 48in length, Keyway sprocket hub 1in bore #40 chain)
Hydraulic disc brake; MCP 0.700in master cylinder generates enough pressure for 500lb mower (e.g., MCP go-kart caliper (piston 1.5in), EBC FA116 brake pads for kart caliper)
Start engine (cranking 200A), power fuel pump (3A) and kill switch circuit (0.5A) (e.g., Group 51R AGM (e.g. Optima YellowTop D51R), NorthStar NSB-AGM35)
Lifts fuel from 1gal ATL cell (3ft below carb) to keep fuel feed at high G cornering (e.g., Walbro 42 series (low pressure 3-5psi), Mikuni DF-52 fuel pump)
Mig weld frame reinforcement, steering mounts, engine plate; 0.035in for 1.5in tube strength (e.g., Lincoln Electric ED031589 0.035in, Hobart H122092 0.035in)
Safety: prevents fuel slosh and rupture; 1 gal = 20min race duration; foam filler helps avoid vapor explosion (e.g., ATL SuperCell 1 gal (black rubber bladder), Fuel Safe 1 gal fuel cell foam-filled)

Maintains constant chain tension on #40 chain (60T-14T sprockets) despite stretch under load (e.g., Gates 3/8in chain idler pulley #7320, Spring-loaded tensioner bracket fabricated from 0.125in steel)

author: mowerracer

name: How to Make a Raised Bed Garden Box From Wood Pallets
summary: Проект строительства грядки-короба для огорода из переработанных деревянных паллет. Цель — создание недорогого, прочного и экологичного решения для выращивания растений в условиях off-grid или ограниченного бюджета, используя часто бесплатный материал.

bom.notes: Основной строительный материал для стенок короба (боковые панели). (e.g., Euro pallet 1200x800mm stringer board (18mm x 100mm x 1200mm))
Соединение углов короба — основные несущие гвозди. (e.g., 3 inch (76mm) hot-dipped galvanized framing nail, 8d (2.5mm diameter))
Крепление поперечных планок к основным доскам боковых сторон (сборка панелей). (e.g., 1.25 inch (32mm) common nail, 6d (2.0mm diameter))

author: survivalize

name: How to Make a Rug From Plastic Grocery Bags
summary: A craft project that transforms discarded plastic grocery bags into a reusable, braided rug. The process involves cutting bags into strips, braiding them into a long rope, coiling the braid into a spiral, and fusing the backing with wax paper and an iron. The result is a durable, decorative floor covering that repurposes waste plastic.

bom.notes: Primary material: cut into strips and braided to form rug coils. (e.g., Standard HDPE plastic grocery bag (approx. 12"x20"))
Backing material: fused to the underside of the braid to hold coils together. (e.g., Reynolds Cut-Rite Wax Paper (standard kitchen roll))
Temporary fixture: holds braid spiral in place while fusing. (e.g., Standard household sewing pins (1-1/2" long))

author: walkerbarb

name: How to Make a Seed Bomb
summary: Проект по созданию «семенных бомб» — небольших комков из глины, компоста и семян, предназначенных для забрасывания на пустыри или труднодоступные участки для озеленения. Подходит для guerilla gardening (партизанского садоводства) и восстановления почвы в городской среде.

bom.notes: Связующее вещество для формирования бомбы; удерживает влагу и защищает семена до прорастания (e.g., глина из местной почвы, Crayola Air Dry Clay (Walmart))
Питательная среда для прорастания семян после попадания бомбы в почву (e.g., мелкий садовый компост, органическое удобрение, биогумус)
Биологический компонент для озеленения и улучшения почвы (e.g., семена полевых цветов (люпин, мак, ромашка), календула, фацелия)
Активация связывания глины и удержание структуры бомбы (e.g., водопроводная вода, дождевая вода)

author: treesneedtobehugged

name: Shoebox iPhone/iPod Projector
summary: A DIY projector made from a shoebox, a magnifying glass, and a smartphone. Uses simple optics to project the phone screen onto a wall, suitable for off-grid movie nights or low-tech entertainment.

bom.notes: Primary optical element: projects phone screen image onto wall. (e.g., plastic or glass magnifying lens, ~100mm diameter, ~300mm focal length)
Light-tight enclosure to hold phone and lens in alignment. (e.g., standard shoebox, approx 30x20x12 cm)
Adhesive stand to hold phone at precise focal distance. (e.g., Play-Doh, air-dry clay, Silly Putty)
Decorative wrapper for shoebox. (e.g., 12x18 inch colored paper)
Secures magnifying glass inside box and attaches paper covering. (e.g., duct tape, packing tape, masking tape)

author: sher179

name: How to Make a Solar Powered Walkway
summary: A project to create a glowing walkway using hacked solar-powered umbrella lights. The solar panels are mounted separately from the LED units, allowing the lights to be embedded in walkway bricks while the panels collect sun in a nearby location.

bom.notes: Complete lighting system with solar panel, NiMH battery, light sensor, and six white LEDs contained in separable units (e.g., Home Depot patio umbrella solar light $8, Generic solar path light with separate panel)
Extension wires to connect solar panel to LED body (3 wires: positive, negative, and light sensor control) (e.g., 22AWG stranded wire (red/black), 18AWG speaker wire)
Energy storage. Two AA cells in series charging from solar panel during day, powering LEDs at night (e.g., AA NiMH 1200mAh, AA NiCd 700mAh)
Charges batteries during daylight hours. Typically provides 2-4V open circuit voltage at 50-200mA (e.g., 2V/100mA polycrystalline panel from umbrella light, Generic 2V-4V 50-200mA solar cell)
Turns LEDs on when ambient light drops below threshold. Integrated on original solar light PCB (e.g., LDR (light dependent resistor) on original PCB, CdS photoresistor)

author: depotdevoid

name: How to Make a Speaker
summary: Проект по созданию простого динамика из подручных материалов: пластикового стаканчика, медной проволоки, неодимовых магнитов и старой гарнитуры. Основан на принципе электромагнита — звуковая катушка, колеблющаяся в магнитном поле, приводит в движение мембрану (дно стаканчика).

bom.notes: Электромагнитный преобразователь — колеблется в поле магнита, создавая звуковые волны через мембрану (e.g., Самодельная звуковая катушка 80 витков, 26 AWG)
Создание постоянного магнитного поля для взаимодействия с катушкой (e.g., Неодимовый магнит 10×5 мм цилиндр, Стопка из 3-4 маленьких неодимовых магнитов)
Подключение к аудиоисточнику (телефон, ПК) (e.g., 3.5 мм разъём от сломанных наушников)
Корпус и мембрана динамика (e.g., Пластиковый стаканчик 200 мл)

author: AH Electronics

name: How to Make a Steambox for Bending Wood
summary: This project describes the construction of a simple, low-cost steam box made from plywood and a household pot. The box uses steam from a heated pot to heat wood, making it pliable for bending into custom shapes, useful for woodworking, boat building, or repair.

bom.notes: Forms the main chamber to contain the steam and wood. (e.g., 5/8-inch plywood sheet)
Provides the heat source to boil water and generate steam. (e.g., Household stove, Hot plate, Propane burner)
Holds water that is boiled to produce steam. The pot mouth must fit the open end of the box. (e.g., Aluminum pot, Stainless steel pot, Enameled steel pot)
Creates a grid inside the box to support the wood above the condensation puddle. (e.g., Coat hanger wire, Stainless steel tie wire, 14-gauge galvanized wire)
Secures the plywood joints and attaches legs to the box. (e.g., #8 wood screws 1-inch, 16-gauge finish nails)

author: nativewater

name: How to Make a Synthetic Diamond
summary: A project to create a synthetic diamond using a standard home microwave oven, graphite pencil lead, and olive oil. The goal is to heat graphite into a plasma to form a small diamond-like crystal as a unique keepsake.

bom.notes: Основной материал: при нагреве в плазме микроволн графит превращается в алмаз. (e.g., Pentel Hi-Polymer 3mm lead, Faber-Castell 3mm lead)
Пропитывается маслом и служит фитилем для доставки масла к графиту в зоне нагрева. (e.g., DMC Perle Cotton размер 8, Gütermann 100% Cotton)
Используется для концентрации микроволновой энергии в локальной точке графита, создавая плазму. (e.g., Bertolli Extra Virgin, Colavita Extra Virgin)
Источник микроволн для возбуждения плазмы в графите. (e.g., LG NeoChef 1200W, Panasonic NN-SN686S)
Термостойкая подставка-тигель для удержания графита в центре микроволновки. (e.g., IKEA VARDAGEN, standard ceramic mug not metallic)

author: mrcrumley

name: How to Make a Tesla Turbine (Greenest Turbine)
summary: A Tesla turbine built from salvaged hard drive platters, PVC pipe, and basic hardware. Uses compressed air to spin a disk stack to high RPMs, demonstrating a friction-based turbine design. Suitable for education and off-grid compressed air energy recovery.

bom.notes: Rotating disk assembly that transfers kinetic energy from compressed air via boundary layer friction (e.g., Salvaged 3.5" hard drive platters (aluminum or glass substrate), 2.5" laptop platters if smaller size acceptable)
Central axle that holds the disk stack and transfers rotation to a load (e.g., 12L14 or C1018 mild steel rod, 150 mm × 6.35 mm diameter)
Support the shaft at each end of the housing with low friction (e.g., SKF 606-2RS, NTN 606ZZ, Generic 6×12×4 mm shielded bearing)
End plates that seal the housing and hold bearings (e.g., Acrylic sheet from hardware store cut with jigsaw)
Turbine housing that contains the spinning disk stack (e.g., 3" nominal (76.2 mm ID) PVC pipe, 55.9 mm long)
Air inlet fitting port (tap 1/8" NPT into it) (e.g., M6 brass coupling nut, 12 mm long)
Control input pressure to turbine within safe limits (2-4 bar) (e.g., Milton 310-4 inline regulator with gauge)
Emergency stop for the turbine (e.g., Ball valve 3/8" barb x barb for 10 mm ID hose)
Connect turbine shaft to a load (optional, for power generation) (e.g., Lovejoy L050 with 6 mm and 6.35 mm bores)
Measure RPM during testing and calibration (e.g., Generic DT-2234C+ handheld tachometer)

author: CrazyMachinist94

name: How to Make a Three Axis CNC Machine (Cheaply and Easily)
summary: A DIY project to build a desktop-sized three-axis CNC router from mostly off-the-shelf parts and MDF sheet stock. The design prioritizes low cost and simplicity, using standard stepper motors and a typical controller board.

bom.notes: Provides rotary cutting action for milling workpieces. (e.g., Dremel 3000, Makita RT0701C trim router)
Drives X, Y, and Z axes linear motion via lead screws or belts. (e.g., NEMA 17 1.8°/step, 0.4-0.6A/phase)
Interprets G-code and generates step/direction signals for the stepper drivers. (e.g., GRBL v0.9j shield on Arduino Uno, RAMPS 1.4 + A4988 drivers)
Provides current-regulated bipolar stepper motor control at high resolution microstepping. (e.g., A4988, DRV8825)
Signals homing reference and over-travel limits for each axis. (e.g., Omron SS-5GL13, generic microswitch (SPDT, 0.5A/125VAC))
Provides rigid linear guide for X, Y, Z axes. (e.g., 3/4" square aluminum tube, 24" length)
Converts rotational motion from stepper into linear motion along each axis. (e.g., M6 threaded rod (1.25mm pitch) + 6mm flexible coupler, M8 ACME lead screw + brass nut)
Structural frame for the CNC machine base and gantry. (e.g., 1/2" thick MDF, 48" x 48")
Provides DC power for the Arduino shield and stepper motor drivers (typically 12V-24V). (e.g., 12V 5A mean well, laptop charger 12V up to 5A)

author: oomlout

name: How to Make a Waterfall/Fairytale Braid
summary: A step-by-step hairstyling tutorial showing how to create a waterfall braid with pinning technique. Requires access to hair, bobby pins, mirror and a brush.
author: Queencess

name: Wooden Spoon, the Viking Way
summary: This project details the traditional Nordic method of carving a wooden spoon from green applewood using hand-forged reconstructions of Viking-era tools. The process involves splitting a fresh log with a wedge, rough-shaping with an axe, fine carving with knives, and finishing with sanding, linseed oil, and optionally wax.

bom.notes: Основной материал для изготовления ложки (e.g., applewood_log_40-50cm, birch_log, cherry_log)
Нанесение контура ложки на заготовку (e.g., древесный уголь из очага)
Пропитка и защита древесины от влаги (e.g., льняное масло холодного отжима, пищевое)
Финишное покрытие для дополнительной защиты (e.g., пчелиный воск натуральный)

author: morfmir

name: How to Make AC Powered "Batteries" for Your DC Powered Devices
summary: Проект по созданию фальшивых батареек из деревянных дюбелей, которые подключаются к AC-адаптеру. Позволяет заменить AA-батарейки в устройстве (например, камере) на проводное питание от сети. Автор предупреждает о риске повреждения устройства при неправильном напряжении.

bom.notes: Преобразует сетевое напряжение 220V AC в постоянное напряжение, соответствующее батарейному питанию устройства (обычно 1.5-12V DC). (e.g., Universal AC adapter 3-12V selectable, Old Nokia charger 3.7V, Any wall wart 3-12V DC)
Изоляционный корпус фальшивой батарейки, внутри которого проходит провод к контакту-винту. (e.g., Дюбель деревянный 8×50 мм, Черенок от садового инструмента)
Контакты фальшивых батареек: винт вкручивается в торец дюбеля и касается плюсовой клеммы устройства. (e.g., Винт M3×12 мм с потайной головкой)
Соединяет AC-адаптер с винтами-контактами внутри дюбелей. (e.g., Монтажный провод МГТФ 0.2 мм², Провод от старого наушника)
Изоляция соединения винта с проводом и фиксация провода в дюбеле. (e.g., Изолента ПВХ чёрная 19 мм, Термоусадочная трубка 3 мм)

author: lspcrash

name: PVC Flute
summary: Проект создания музыкальной флейты из ПВХ-трубы. Подходит для школьных проектов и любительского изготовления. Включает разметку, сверление отверстий и декорирование.

bom.notes: Резонатор и корпус флейты (e.g., PVC pipe 3/4 inch ID)

author: EastsidePrep

name: How to Make an Iron Man Mask
summary: This project details how to build a wearable Iron Man mask from cardboard, newspaper, and paper mache techniques. The mask is shaped with multiple layers of cardboard and newspaper, painted with gold paint, and optionally integrates LED lights for the eyes powered by a 9V battery.

bom.notes: Illuminates the eyes of the mask for a glowing effect (e.g., Kingbright WP7113WC, generic 5mm white LED)
Limits current to white LEDs when powered by 9V battery (e.g., generic 100Ω 1/4W carbon film)
Portable power source for LED eyes (e.g., Duracell 9V, generic 9V alkaline)
Connects 9V battery to LED circuit (e.g., Keystone 235, generic 9V snap connector)
Interconnects battery, resistor, and LEDs (e.g., generic 22AWG stranded hookup wire)
Base structural layers for mask front and back (e.g., corrugated cardboard sheet 2mm thick)
Paper mache bulk material to shape the mask (e.g., newspaper sheets)
Mixed with water for paper mache adhesive (e.g., Elmer's Glue-All)
Final coat for Iron Man gold finish (e.g., FolkArt Metallic Gold, generic gold acrylic craft paint)
Base coat under gold paint for opacity (e.g., generic white acrylic craft paint)

author: msraynsford

name: How to Make Any Home Appliance Into a Solar Electric Hybrid
summary: A DIY project to convert any 120V home appliance into a solar-electric hybrid by adding a small solar panel, 12V battery, charge controller, inverter, and automatic switching circuit. The system automatically switches between grid power and solar/battery power when the inverter is active, reducing grid electricity consumption.

bom.notes: Primary energy source: converts sunlight to 12V DC to charge the battery (e.g., 5W Harbor Freight 12V solar panel, 10W Renogy 12V panel)
Stores solar energy for use when solar is unavailable (night/cloudy) (e.g., 12V 7Ah SLA battery, 12V 20Ah deep-cycle AGM)
Converts 12V DC battery power to 120V AC for the appliance (e.g., 80W Harbor Freight power inverter, 300W modified sine wave inverter)
Provides stable 5V reference for the 555 timer comparator circuit (e.g., 7805 in TO-220, LM7805)
Acts as a comparator with hysteresis to maintain battery voltage between 12.0V and 14.4V (e.g., NE555, LM555)
Buffers the 555 output to drive the relay coil (200mA relay draw) (e.g., MPS2222A, 2N2222A, BC547)
Disconnects solar panel from battery when battery is full (14.4V) and reconnects at 12.0V (e.g., 12V SPDT relay, coil 200mA, Omron G5V-2)
Automatic switching between grid (wall) and inverter output; DPDT switches both hot and neutral (e.g., Radio Shack 275-217, Omron LY2-AC120)
2 for reverse polarity protection on battery input; 1 as flyback diode across relay coil; 1 for freewheeling (e.g., 1N4001, 1N4007)
Set charge thresholds: one for high-voltage disconnect (14.4V), one for low-voltage reconnect (12.0V) (e.g., 10kΩ trimpot, 3296W, 10kΩ panel mount potentiometer)
Filter capacitor on 7805 input for stability (e.g., 100µF 25V electrolytic, 100µF 16V)
Bypass capacitors on 7805 output and NE555 supply pin (e.g., 0.1µF ceramic disc, 104 capacitor)
Cut to provide male plug (wall input), female socket (appliance output), and wires for inverter input (e.g., 6ft 18AWG extension cord, 10ft 16AWG outdoor cord)
Houses automatic switching circuit and relay for safety (e.g., 3×2×1" plastic box, ABS junction box 4×4×2")
Overcurrent protection on battery line (solar to battery) rated for 5A max solar current (e.g., 5A fast-blow glass fuse, 5A ATC blade fuse)

author: DIY Hacks and How Tos

name: Bagpipes from a Garbage Bag and Recorders
summary: This project shows how to build a simple bagpipe-like instrument using a plastic garbage bag and two recorders. It creates a functional wind instrument where one recorder plays a constant drone and the other plays a melody.

bom.notes: Acts as the air reservoir for the bagpipe. (e.g., household garbage bag, large plastic shopping bag)
One serves as the drone (plays a constant note), the other as the chanter (plays the melody). (e.g., Soprano recorder, PVC recorder (DIY))
Forms the blowpipe through which air is blown into the bag. (e.g., disassembled ballpoint pen body, straw, piece of hose)
Seals all connections between the bag, blowpipe, and recorders to prevent air leaks. (e.g., duct tape, electrical tape, packing tape)
Used to cut the bag and create holes. (e.g., household scissors)

author: wasabi32746

name: How To: Make Bath Bombs
summary: Пошаговое руководство по изготовлению шипучих бомбочек для ванны из смеси соды, лимонной кислоты, масел и ароматизаторов. Проект охватывает смешивание сухих и влажных ингредиентов, формовку и сушку готовых изделий.

bom.notes: Основной шипучий компонент, реагирует с кислотой с образованием CO2 (e.g., baking_soda)
Кислота для реакции с содой и создания пузырьков (e.g., citric_acid_powder)
Наполнитель, замедляет реакцию, делает бомбочку более плотной (e.g., cornstarch, potato_starch)
Смягчает воду, полезен для мышц (e.g., epsom_salt)
Связующее, увлажняет кожу (e.g., coconut_oil, almond_oil, olive_oil)
Ароматизация, расслабляющий эффект (e.g., lavender_essential_oil, orange_essential_oil)
Активатор реакции (очень мало) (e.g., distilled_water)
Связующее и натуральный консервант (e.g., witch_hazel_extract)

author: SoapyHollow

name: How to Make Cannabis Coconut Oil (Canna Oil)
summary: Метод извлечения активных компонентов каннабиса в кокосовое масло для последующего употребления в пищу или самостоятельного приема. Включает декароксилацию, медленную экстракцию на водяной бане и фильтрацию через марлю.

bom.notes: Active ingredient source (THC/CBD) for extraction into oil (e.g., cannabis_trim_40g, cannabis_buds_40g, kief_40g)
Lipid solvent to dissolve cannabinoids and terpenes from plant material; provides bioavailability (e.g., unrefined_coconut_oil, mct_oil)
Separates plant solids from liquid oil after extraction (e.g., cheesecloth, muslin_cloth, nylon_nut_milk_bag)

author: cannalove

name: How to Make Cherry Blossom Lights
summary: A decorative DIY project to create indoor cherry blossom branches using tissue paper flowers and battery-powered LED lights. The lights are attached to a real branch, covered with hand-cut tissue blossoms, and displayed in a vase with gravel.

bom.notes: Provides illumination inside each tissue paper blossom, creating the glowing effect (e.g., White LED Christmas lights (battery powered), 20-LED string)
Diffuses and softens the LED light, giving a more natural blossom glow (e.g., Plastic stamen from dollar store flowers)

author: ChrysN

name: How to Make Evil Childproof Caps Easy to Open
summary: This project provides five distinct mechanical modifications to childproof bottle caps (push-down-and-turn, squeeze-and-turn, push-down-tab, line-up-arrows, and one-piece squeeze-and-turn) to make them easy to open for adults without children present. Each method uses common household tools like thumbtacks, toothpicks, fingernail clippers, or pliers with a total time investment of 10-60 seconds per cap.

bom.notes: Acts as a mechanical lock between the outer spinning cap and inner threaded cap on push-down-and-turn bottle caps. (e.g., Pushpin type 12mm head, 10mm pin, Office supply thumbtack)

Acts as a non-piercing spacer to lock the outer and inner caps together on push-down-and-turn caps, suitable for liquid containers. (e.g., Standard flat wooden toothpick, Plastic stir stick from coffee cup)
Optional adhesive to secure the toothpick wedge in place for a permanent fix. Not strictly required. (e.g., Loctite 401, Gorilla Super Glue, Generic cyanoacrylate gel)

author: SFHandyman

name: How to Make Faux Rocks
summary: A DIY tutorial on creating artificial rocks from cardboard, chicken wire, and mortar for garden decoration. The author describes their first experimental attempt using cheap, salvaged materials to create a realistic-looking faux rock.

bom.notes: Base structural form for the faux rock (e.g., corrugated cardboard box, shipping box)
Filler to bulk up the rock shape and reduce cement weight (e.g., old newspapers, scrap paper)
Reinforcement mesh to hold mortar on the cardboard form (e.g., 2-inch chicken wire, poultry netting)
Adhesive for attaching cardboard extensions (e.g., Elmer's glue, craft glue)
Binder for mortar mix to form rock surface (e.g., Portland cement, Quikrete)
Aggregate for mortar mix to reduce shrinkage and add strength (e.g., play sand, construction sand)
Flexible patch material for filling gaps in cured mortar (e.g., polymer-modified tile adhesive, FlexBond)
Coloring agent to tint mortar for natural rock appearance (e.g., concrete stain, pigment powder)
Surface coating for color and weathering detail (e.g., outdoor acrylic craft paint, latex paint)
Platform to rotate form during mortar application for even coverage (e.g., Lazy Susan bearing, rotating platform)

author: Creativeman

name: How to Make FM Transmitter
summary: This project is a short-range FM transmitter that broadcasts audio from an external device (e.g. MP3 player) to a standard FM radio. It operates in the 88-108 MHz band and is built with discrete through-hole components on a homemade PCB.

bom.notes: Q1 as audio preamplifier, Q2 as RF oscillator and modulator (e.g., 2N3904)
Frequency tuning in resonant LC tank circuit (L1 + trimmer) (e.g., 40pF trimmer (ceramic or film))
Resonant tank with trimmer capacitor — determines oscillation frequency (e.g., 5 turns 0.5mm Cu wire, 4mm diameter)
Collector load resistor for Q2 (e.g., 1kΩ carbon film, 1/4W)
Base bias resistors for Q1 and Q2, and audio input series resistor (e.g., 10kΩ carbon film, 1/4W)
Feedback resistor from Q2 collector to base for biasing (e.g., 100kΩ carbon film, 1/4W)
Base resistor for Q1 audio preamp stage (e.g., 1MΩ carbon film, 1/4W)
Emitter resistor for Q2 — stabilizes oscillator (e.g., 100Ω carbon film, 1/4W)
Decoupling on power supply (C1) and audio coupling (C2) (e.g., 0.1µF ceramic disc)
Feedback path from Q2 collector to base — ensures oscillation (e.g., 10pF ceramic disc, NPO)
Small coupling capacitor from oscillator to antenna (e.g., 4.7pF ceramic disc, NPO)
Power source for the transmitter circuit (e.g., 9V alkaline PP3)
Radiating element for FM band transmission (e.g., 17.3 cm insulated copper wire)

author: JunezRiyaz

name: How to Make Goop!
summary: An easy, child-friendly science experiment that creates a non-Newtonian fluid (oobleck) from cornstarch and water. The mixture behaves as a liquid when handled gently and a solid when stressed, demonstrating basic principles of material science in a fun, tactile way.
author: jmccarte

name: How to Make Infused Oil
summary: Это руководство по изготовлению ароматизированных и лечебных масел методом холодной и горячей экстракции. Подходит для кулинарных целей, а также для создания масел для ароматерапии, массажа и косметики. Проект не содержит электроники и является чисто кулинарно-косметическим.
author: ChrysN

name: How to Make Nail Polish
summary: Этот проект учит создавать собственные цвета лака для ногтей, смешивая прозрачную основу с измельченными тенями для век или глиттером. Процесс предельно прост и подходит для быстрого DIY без специальных навыков.

bom.notes: Базовая прозрачная основа для растворения и фиксации пигментов и глиттера на ногтях. (e.g., Wet n Wild Clear Nail Polish, Sally Hansen)
Источник цветного пигмента для окрашивания лака в нужный оттенок. (e.g., Wet n Wild eyeshadow palette, Maybelline single eyeshadow)
Добавляет блестящие частицы в лак для декоративного эффекта. (e.g., Fine cosmetic glitter, Craft glitter (ultra-fine, cosmetic-safe preferred))
Воронка из бумаги для чистого засыпания порошка/глиттера в узкое горлышко флакона. (e.g., Printer paper sheet torn into 4 pieces)
Инструмент для перемешивания и проталкивания порошка в горлышко флакона. (e.g., Bamboo toothpick)
Соскабливание теней из компакта и измельчение их на твердой поверхности. (e.g., Standard butter knife)

author: jessyratfink

name: Organic Planting Pots from Old Newspapers
summary: A no-cost, zero-waste method to create biodegradable seedling pots from old newspapers and a bottle. The pots can be planted directly into the ground, reducing transplant shock and plastic waste. No electronics, power tools, or technical skills required.

bom.notes: Forms the physical pot structure to hold soil and seeds until transplanting (e.g., newspaper sheet, magazine paper)
Provides nutrients, structure and weight to the pot; prevents newspaper collapse (e.g., potting soil, garden soil, seed-starting mix)
Germinates into seedling for transplanting (e.g., tomato seeds, pepper seeds, herb seeds)
Acts as mandrel to wrap newspaper into cylindrical pot shape (e.g., glass beer bottle, plastic soda bottle (500ml-2L))

author: yngla

name: How to Make Palm Crosses
summary: This project teaches the traditional method of folding palm fronds into small crosses for Palm Sunday celebrations. It uses pre-cut palm fronds and requires only manual dexterity, no tools or electronics, to create a symbolic religious ornament.
author: Fandragon

name: How to Make PCB at Home
summary: Руководство по изготовлению печатных плат (PCB) в домашних условиях с использованием метода лазерно-утюжной технологии (LUT) или ручного рисования маркером. Проект описывает процесс от создания разводки в EDA-программе до травления и финишной обработки платы.

bom.notes: Пример схемы Touch Switch использует таймер NE555 для управления реле (e.g., NE555P, CD4017BE)
Делитель напряжения и ограничитель тока базы транзистора / 555 таймера (e.g., 1kΩ 1/4W, 10kΩ 1/4W)
Фильтрация питания по +5V и сглаживание пульсаций на выходе таймера (e.g., 47µF 16V electrolytic, 100µF 16V electrolytic)
Развязывающие керамические конденсаторы по питанию таймера (e.g., 100nF MLCC X7R)
Усиление тока с выхода 555 для управления нагрузкой (светодиод/реле) (e.g., BC547B, 2N2222A)
Индикация прикосновения / состояния выхода (e.g., 5mm red LED)
Основа для изготовления платы (односторонний стеклотекстолит с медной фольгой) (e.g., Cu-clad FR-4 100x70mm 35µm)
Перемычки для неразведённых дорожек на односторонней плате (e.g., 22AWG tinned copper wire 0.64mm)

author: Engg_suraj

name: How to Make Perfume
summary: DIY guide to creating custom perfume or cologne at home using vodka and essential oils. The process involves blending scents, aging the mixture, and diluting it with water and glycerine. This project teaches the basics of perfume composition and allows for personalized fragrance creation.

bom.notes: Base solvent that dissolves and carries essential/fragrance oils and evaporates from skin leaving only the scent (e.g., vodka 80-100 proof, Everclear 190 proof, grain alcohol 95%)

Provides the actual fragrance notes — top (citrus/herbal), middle (floral/spicy), base (woody/resinous) to create layered scent profile (e.g., lavender essential oil, sandalwood essential oil, lemon essential oil)
Dilutes the alcohol concentrate to reduce skin irritation and control fragrance strength; comprises 30-40% of final perfume (e.g., distilled water, spring water)
Acts as humectant and preservative — helps fragrance last longer on skin and prevents alcohol from drying out the mixture (e.g., vegetable glycerine, pharmaceutical glycerine USP)

author: ChrysN

name: How to Make Playdough (Play-doh)
summary: Рецепт приготовления нетоксичного, съедобного и безопасного для детей пластилина в домашних условиях. Смесь муки, соли, масла и воды варится на плите, затем вручную вымешивается с добавлением пищевых красителей.

bom.notes: Основной наполнитель и структурообразователь. Создает эластичную матрицу. (e.g., Wheat flour, all-purpose flour, bread flour)
Консервант (предотвращает плесень), придает соленый вкус, помогает связывать влагу. (e.g., Iodized salt, sea salt, regular table salt)
Пластификатор, предотвращает высыхание и уменьшает липкость. Добавляет гладкость текстуре. (e.g., Sunflower oil, canola oil, olive oil extra light)
Растворитель, среда для клейстеризации крахмала, активация солевого раствора. (e.g., Tap water heated to ~40°C)
Придание цвета пластилину. Любой пищевой краситель для окрашивания продукта. (e.g., Liquid food coloring, gel food coloring, powdered food coloring)

author: canida

name: How to MAKE PV Solar Panels
summary: Руководство по сборке небольших солнечных панелей из дешёвых битых кристаллических кремниевых ячеек, а также из аморфных стеклянных и CIGS-элементов. Описана подготовка ячеек, пайка табелей, соединение в последовательные цепочки и герметизация в рамки. Панели мощностью 1-2 Вт подходят для зарядки аккумуляторов в автономных системах.

bom.notes: Фотоэлектрическое преобразование в цепочке 0.5 В/ячейка (e.g., Сломанные 156x156 мм кремниевые ячейки n-типа, Дешёвые ячейки grade B с аукционов)
Защита от обратного тока аккумулятора в панель ночью (e.g., 1N5817, 1N5819, SB120)
Соединение шин ячеек между собой (e.g., Лужёный медный провод 0.64 мм²)
Контакт к проводящему слою стеклянной (аморфной) ячейки (e.g., Медная сетка 100 mesh из магазина для ВЧ-экранирования)
Герметизация краёв панели и фиксация ячеек на подложке (e.g., Прозрачный силиконовый герметик Dow Corning 732)

author: VIRON

name: How to Make the Mini Metal Foundry
summary: Проект создания небольшой плавильной печи для литья алюминия в домашних условиях. Используется смесь песка и гипса для огнеупорной футеровки, стальной контейнер для корпуса и пропановый баллон для тигля. Проект позволяет переплавлять алюминиевые банки и другие мелкие детали.

bom.notes: Основной корпус печи — удерживает огнеупорную футеровку. (e.g., 10 quart steel bucket (home depot type) or galvanized steel pail)
Тигель для плавления металла — выдерживает высокие температуры. (e.g., 14 oz propane cylinder (Coleman style) or small camping gas canister)
Огнеупорная футеровка и теплоизоляция корпуса. (e.g., Play sand fine grade + Plaster of Paris + water (4:1 ratio))
Патрубок для подачи воздуха в печь (сопло). (e.g., 1 inch black steel pipe nipple (schedule 40), or any 1 inch O.D. metal tube)
Защитное покрытие корпуса от коррозии. (e.g., Rust-Oleum Burnished Amber high heat spray paint (up to 1200°F))
Подача приточного воздуха для горения угля/палок. (e.g., Hair dryer (low heat setting), or 4 inch desk fan, or shop vac exhaust)
Топливо для нагрева печи. (e.g., Charcoal briquettes (Kingsford), or wood charcoal chunks)

author: The King of Random

name: How to Make USB OTG Cable
summary: Инструкция по изготовлению компактного кабеля USB OTG (On-The-Go) из старых разъемов. Позволяет подключать клавиатуру, мышь или USB-накопитель к смартфону или планшету.

bom.notes: Основной хост-порт для подключения USB-устройств (клавиатура, флешка, мышь). (e.g., USB-A panel mount female, USB-A breakouts)
Разъем для подключения к смартфону или планшету. Пин ID замыкается на GND для активации OTG-режима. (e.g., USB-micro B male plug, кабель micro USB)
Соединение контактов Vbus, D-, D+, GND между двумя разъёмами. (e.g., витая пара 28AWG, монтажный провод 0.1мм²)

author: Jakes  workshop

name: Deadmau5 Mau5head Costume
summary: Build a wearable replica of Deadmau5's iconic mouse helmet using a hamster ball, hard hat, felt, and craft materials. This costume project covers cutting, wrapping, and assembling the headpiece with optional LED lighting.

bom.notes: Optional lighting inside eyes for glow effect (e.g., 5mm red LED, 5mm white LED, generic 5mm LED)
Current limiting for each LED to prevent burnout (e.g., 220Ω 1/4W carbon film, 220Ω 1/2W metal film)
Portable power source (6V) for LED lighting circuit (e.g., 4xAA battery holder with switch, 6V PP3 battery clip)
Wiring from battery holder to LEDs through head (e.g., 22 AWG stranded wire, 22 AWG solid core)
On/off control for LED circuit (e.g., Mini toggle switch SPST, Slider switch SPST)

author: PastaNoodles

name: How to Make Your Own Sugru Substitute (Oogoo)
summary: This project describes how to create Oogoo, an inexpensive silicone clay substitute for Sugru, using 100% clear silicone caulk and corn starch. It covers mixing ratios, hand molding, casting, coloring, sanding, and creating flexible circuits with conductive glue, including a robot pumpkin head with LEDs controlled by a Picaxe microcontroller.

bom.notes: Base material for Oogoo; provides flexible silicone matrix (e.g., GE Silicone I (100% silicone, clear), DAP 100% silicone caulk (clear))
Filler and curing accelerator for silicone; controls set time and stiffness (e.g., Argo corn starch, Any grocery store brand)
Dye for Oogoo; fine pigment provides vibrant colors without affecting cure (if used in tiny amounts) (e.g., Winsor & Newton oil paint (any color), Gamblin oil paint)
Adhesive base for conductive glue; bonds to silicone, cloth, and metals (e.g., Gorilla Wood Glue original)
Conductive filler in glue to make carbon traces for LED connections (e.g., Carbon black powder (e.g., Cabot Vulcan XC72), Graphite powder from pencils (finely ground))
Thinner for silicone paint; evaporates to leave silicone coating (e.g., VM&P Naphtha, Mineral spirits (odourless), Zippo lighter fluid (contains naphtha))
Flexible circuit board substrate; etched to form traces (e.g., Veilshield (conductive textile), Lame Lifestyles conductive fabric)
Visual output for robot pumpkin head; flashed via microcontroller (e.g., LED 5mm diffused (any color), LED 3mm clear (if smaller needed))
Power source for LED circuit; provides 3-3.7V (e.g., CR2032 3V coin cell, Li-ion 3.7V 120mAh (e.g., from old Bluetooth earbud))
Controls LED sequences via Charliplexing; low pin count (3 pins can drive 6 LEDs) (e.g., Picaxe 08M2 (current version), Picaxe 08M (legacy))
Connections from Picaxe to battery and to the conductive cloth circuit (via solder joints) (e.g., 22 AWG hookup wire (solid or stranded), 22 AWG silicone wire)

author: mikey77

name: How to Measure Things Without a Ruler
summary: A practical guide for estimating measurements using common everyday objects when a traditional ruler or tape measure is unavailable. The project leverages standardized sizes of items like credit cards, dollar bills, and coins as makeshift measuring tools.

bom.notes: Provide 3.5-inch (89 mm) and 2-inch (51 mm) reference lengths. (e.g., credit card, bank card, loyalty card)
Provide 6-inch (152 mm) primary length reference, foldable for fractions. (e.g., U.S. dollar bill, any $1–$100 bill)
Provide 1-inch (25.4 mm) diameter reference for small measurements. (e.g., U.S. quarter (25¢), any quarter-sized coin)
Provide approximate 2.3-inch (58 mm) width reference. (e.g., iPhone 5S, iPhone SE, most modern smartphones ~60–80 mm wide)

author: amalkhan

name: How-To: Motors
summary: Руководство по основам работы с различными типами моторов для DIY-проектов. Описывает теорию работы DC-моторов, шаговых двигателей, сервоприводов и вибромоторов, а также даёт практические советы по подключению к Arduino и питанию от батарей.

bom.notes: Исполнительный механизм для непрерывного вращения (колёса робота, вентилятор). (e.g., FA-130, RF-300, Mabuchi RS-540)
Позиционирование по шагам (линейный привод, ось 3D-принтера). (e.g., 28BYJ-48, NEMA 17)
Точное позиционирование от 0 до 180° (поворот камеры, рука робота). (e.g., SG90, MG90S, MG996R)
Тактильная обратная связь/вибрация (пульты, игрушки). (e.g., ERM LRA 10mm, 1030/1020 coin vibration motor)
Контроллер для генерации ШИМ-сигналов и управления моторами. (e.g., Arduino Uno R3, Arduino Nano, ATmega328P)
Усиление тока для шагового мотора (ULN2003) или H-мост для DC (L293D). (e.g., ULN2003 module, A4988, L293D)
Питание драйвера/Arduino (6V от 4×AA) для портативного использования. (e.g., 4×AA battery holder with switch)
Соединение компонентов на макетной плате. (e.g., 22 AWG stranded wire, Dupont jumper wires M-F)

author: audreyobscura

name: How to Multiply Your Spider Plants
summary: This project describes two simple methods for propagating spider plants (Chlorophytum comosum) from the baby plantlets (spiders) that grow on the parent plant's stems. It covers starting the baby plants in water to encourage root growth before transplanting, or planting them directly into soil for immediate propagation. Basic care instructions for the new plants are also provided.

bom.notes: The biological plant material that is propagated to create a new spider plant. (e.g., Chlorophytum comosum baby spider plant)
Growth medium for the new spider plant roots after propagation. (e.g., general purpose potting soil, peat-based)
Used as the growth medium for root development in the water propagation method, and for hydration after planting in soil. (e.g., clean, room-temperature tap water, or distilled/rainwater)

author: sacred

name: How to Open a Locked Door the Macgyver Way
summary: A low-cost, non-destructive method for opening a locked interior door using a vacuum cleaner cable, dental floss, and a piece of paper. The technique creates a loop that hooks the interior doorknob to turn it from outside the room.

bom.notes: Target mechanism that rotates to retract latch (e.g., standard interior doorknob with lever or round knob)
Creates loop around interior doorknob to turn it from outside (e.g., vacuum cleaner power cord, extension cord, thick phone charging cable)
Pulls cable into position behind the door (e.g., dental floss, fishing line 10lb, thin string)
Weight and guide tool to feed floss over door top (e.g., printer paper, notebook page, index card)
Extract paper from under door when fingers can't reach (e.g., bent wire hanger, long tweezers, ruler)

author: hackzorz

name: How to Open and Close a Combination Lock
summary: A beginner's tutorial for opening and closing a standard 3-number combination lock, such as those used on school lockers. The guide covers resetting the dial, inputting the combination sequence correctly, and securing the lock after use.
author: trainsarecool

name: Paint a Mural in a Child's Nursery
summary: A step-by-step guide to painting a custom mural in a child's nursery using a homemade projector. The project shows how to trace and enlarge a magazine image onto a wall, then paint it by hand.
author: mmelville3

name: How to Paint Clean Lines
summary: A painting technique guide for achieving crisp color boundaries using masking tape. Describes a bleed-line method where the first color is painted along the tape edge to seal it, preventing the second color from bleeding under.

bom.notes: Apply second color over large areas quickly, evenly (e.g., Wooster 9-inch roller frame with 3/8 inch nap cover, Purdy 9-inch roller cage)
Draw bleed line along tape edge and cut-in corners (e.g., Purdy 2-inch angled sash brush, Wooster 2.5-inch angled brush)
Create the physical barrier between two colors (e.g., 3M ScotchBlue 1.88 inch painter's tape (delicate surface), FrogTape 1.5 inch painter's tape)
Two separate colors for the design (e.g., Sherwin-Williams Duration interior latex (Color A and Color B), Behr Premium Plus interior latex)
Seal surface for better paint adhesion and color consistency (e.g., KILZ Original interior primer, Zinsser Bulls Eye 1-2-3 primer)

author: starshipminivan

name: How to Pick Simple Locks/Latches With a Paper Clip
summary: This guide demonstrates how to bypass several common low-security locks and latches found in household and commercial environments using only a paperclip. It covers techniques for opening improperly hung doors, privacy locks, simple latches, cheap luggage locks, and dispenser cabinets, emphasizing the vulnerability of cheaply constructed mechanisms.

bom.notes: The paperclip is bent into a hook tool to mechanically manipulate internal latch mechanisms. (e.g., Standard #1 paperclip, Office paperclip 1.5" length)

author: DIY Hacks and How Tos

name: HOW TO PLAN a FUN TREASURE HUNT
summary: A guide for organizing an outdoor treasure hunt for children using picture clues, word scrambles, anagrams, sketches, and props. The hunt spans multiple locations from a home yard to a city park and state park, culminating in a candy treasure chest.
author: Joyful Daisy

name: How to Play BS: a Game of Bluffing
summary: Инструкция по игре в карточную игру BS (Блеф), цель которой — избавиться от всех карт, блефуя о том, какие карты вы кладете. Не является электронным или инженерным проектом, а скорее развлекательным руководством по настольной игре.

bom.notes: Основной элемент игры для всех игровых действий (e.g., standard_bicycle_deck)
Сокрытие выражения глаз для усиления стратегии блефа (опционально) (e.g., aviator_sunglasses, wayfarer)

author: stephenmack

name: How to Play Mancala
summary: Обучение правилам и стратегии настольной игры Манкала. Инструкция объясняет как расставить фишки, ходить, захватывать камни противника и выигрывать. Включает основные исключения и тактические приемы.

bom.notes: Игровой набор для игры в Манкалу (e.g., Доска с 12 лунками + 2 манкалы, 48 камней/фишек/бобов)

author: YummyPancakes

name: How to Polish Resin
summary: A step-by-step guide to sanding and polishing 3D-printed resin parts to a high-gloss finish. Covers hand sanding from 120 to 2000 grit, wet sanding, rubbing/polishing compounds, and buffing with tripoli, white diamond, and carnauba wax. Also discusses power sanding pitfalls and automated vibratory polishing.

bom.notes: Abrasive material for progressive smoothing of resin surface from rough to fine (e.g., 3M 120-2000 grit sandpaper pack, Norton wet/dry sandpaper sheets)
Coarse abrasive paste to remove 2000-grit sanding marks and start polishing (e.g., Turtle Wax Rubbing Compound, 3M Perfect-It Rubbing Compound)
Fine abrasive paste to bring out initial gloss on resin surface (e.g., Turtle Wax Polishing Compound, Meguiar's Ultimate Polish)
Wax-based abrasive compound for initial buffing stage on linen wheel (e.g., Beall Buffing Kit Tripoli bar, Caswell Tripoli compound)
Fine buffing compound for second stage on softer wheel, removes tripoli marks (e.g., Beall White Diamond compound, Jewelers Rouge White compound)
Final protective wax layer providing high-gloss finish and UV resistance (e.g., Turtle Wax Carnauba Wax, Johnson's Paste Wax)
First-stage buffing wheel for tripoli compound, provides aggressive cut (e.g., Beall 3-inch linen wheel, Caswell stitched linen wheel)
Second-stage buffing wheel for white diamond compound, softer cloth for finer finish (e.g., Beall loose cotton wheel, Caswell flannel wheel)

author: noahw

name: How to Prevent Pimples and Reduce Acne Naturally by Eating Right
summary: A dietary guide explaining the relationship between high glycemic load foods, insulin levels, and acne. It provides a structured approach to reducing acne by avoiding processed and refined foods in favor of whole, low-glycemic alternatives.
author: ewilhelm

name: How to Propagate a Pothos Plant

author: AliciaMD84

name: How to Throw Throwing Knives
summary: A beginner's guide to the art of knife throwing. Covers knife selection, target setup, proper stance and grip, and the techniques for half-spin and full-spin throws. Emphasizes safety and consistent practice to build muscle memory.

bom.notes: Заготовка для тела ножа — проковка, опиловка и заточка. (e.g., Вал от двигателя стиральной машины 3×25×300 мм)
Мишень — мягкая сердцевина для захвата ножа. (e.g., Доска сосновая 200×300×50 мм)
Заточка острия ножа под углом 20 градусов. (e.g., Брусок алмазный 150/400 grit)
Ковка и правка острия ножа. (e.g., Молоток слесарный 500 г)
Фиксация заготовки для опиловки и шлифовки. (e.g., Тиски слесарные 100 мм)

author: bergerab

name: How to Tie a Florist Bow
summary: This project provides a detailed, step-by-step guide to creating professional-looking florist bows using ribbon and floral wire. It focuses on technique, particularly the 'secret twist' that keeps the ribbon's right side visible and ensures the bow stays tight.

bom.notes: The primary material for forming the bow loops and tails. Wired ribbon holds its shape. (e.g., 3 yards wired ribbon, 2-4 inches wide)
Secures the center of the bow, holds loops in place, and provides a method to attach the bow to objects. (e.g., 18-22 gauge green florist wire, 9-10 inches)

author: craftknowitall

name: How to Tighten a Chainsaw Chain
summary: Практическое руководство по правильному натяжению цепи бензопилы. Описывает пошаговый процесс ослабления гаек, регулировки натяжного винта и фиксации с поднятым носом шины для предотвращения повреждений.

bom.notes: Рабочий элемент для резки древесины. Требует натяжения для безопасной работы. (e.g., Oregon 72LPX, Stihl 36RM3 63)
Направляющая для цепи, обеспечивает точный рез. (e.g., Oregon 180SDEA041, Stihl 18" Rollomatic E)
Механизм точной регулировки натяжения цепи через винт с резьбой M5. (e.g., Stihl 1122 650 7700, Oregon 56-100)
Фиксируют боковую панель и шину к корпусу бензопилы. (e.g., M10×1.25 flanged nuts)

author: toolrepair

name: How to Turn Your Bleach-stained-red Bathtub White Again
summary: A simple method to restore a bathtub that turned red/pink after bleach exposure, using hydrogen peroxide or oxygen-based cleaners. The process involves spraying or applying the solution and letting it sit for a few minutes to reverse the chemical stain caused by bleach residue mixing with iron in the water.
author: SelkeyMoonbeam

name: How to Use a Bidet
summary: A guide explaining the proper procedure for using a standalone bidet, primarily for personal hygiene after using the toilet. It covers the steps from initial dry wipe to using the bidet's spray and drying off, with notes for females and modern bidet attachments.
author: laminterious

name: How to Use a Breadboard
summary: Учебное пособие по использованию макетной платы для создания электронных схем без пайки. Содержит базовые примеры сборки резисторных цепей и простой схемы с LED.

bom.notes: Индикатор, демонстрирующий работу схемы на макетной плате (e.g., 5mm white LED forward voltage ~3V)
Токоограничивающий резистор для LED (I = (9V - 3V) / 300Ω ≈ 20mA) (e.g., Carbon film 300Ω ±5% 1/4W (color bands: orange-black-brown-gold))
Соединения между шинами питания и компонентами (e.g., Solid-core copper wire 22AWG with stripped ends ~10mm)
Основа для сборки схемы без пайки (e.g., 830 tie-point breadboard, ABS plastic)
Источник питания для LED и резистора (e.g., 9V alkaline battery 6LR61, 9V DC wall adapter with barrel jack)

author: shams

name: How to Use a Stepper Motor
summary: An introductory guide to using a 24BYJ48A hybrid stepper motor with a microcontroller (Digilent chipKIT uC32) and a ULN2803A Darlington transistor array. Covers stepper motor theory, wiring types (unipolar vs bipolar), driving methods (full step, half step, microstepping), and practical circuit construction on a breadboard.

bom.notes: Главный управляющий контроллер: генерирует 4 последовательных сигнала для драйвера шагового двигателя (e.g., Digilent chipKIT uC32, Arduino Mega 2560)
Драйвер шагового двигателя: обеспечивает ток до 500mA на канал для управления обмотками 24BYJ48A (e.g., ULN2803A, ULN2003A)
Исполнительный механизм для точного позиционирования с шагом 1.8° (при half step — 0.9°) (e.g., 24BYJ48A)
Питание всего проекта: 5V/500mA для контроллера + двигатель (e.g., 5V/1A USB wall adapter, 9V battery + 7805 regulator)
Монтажная плата для размещения компонентов без пайки (breadboard) или постоянного монтажа (e.g., 830-point breadboard, perfboard 7x9cm)
Соединения между breadboard, ULN2803A и stepper motor (e.g., 22AWG solid core hookup wire, Dupont male-to-female jumpers)

author: JColvin91

name: How to Wash Stuffed Animals
summary: A guide for cleaning heavily soiled stuffed animals by submerging, scrubbing, and rinsing them, despite 'surface wash only' labels. The method rescues beloved toys from being discarded due to unsanitary conditions.
author: hippie_mama

name: How to Wear a Bharatanatyam Dance Dress
summary: This guide provides step-by-step instructions for donning a complete Bharatanatyam dance costume, including the blouse, pyjama, hair styling with extensions, pallu draping, makeup, and traditional jewelry. It is a cultural and performance preparation guide, not an electronics or survival project.

bom.notes: Upper body garment to which the Pallu is pinned. (e.g., ready-made Bharatanatyam blouse, custom-tailored blouse)
Lower body garment worn under the Pallu fan arrangement. (e.g., Bharatanatyam pyjama with drawstrings)
Extends the natural hair plait to create the traditional long braid look. (e.g., pre-plaited hair extension, single braid extension)
Decorative tassel tied at the end of the hair plait. (e.g., red and gold Kunjalam)
Worn around the hair bun for decoration and fragrance. (e.g., jasmine Gajra, artificial jasmine Gajra)
Draped outer garment that forms the distinctive fan shape in front. (e.g., Kanchipuram silk Pallu, Bharatanatyam costume Pallu)
Attached at the waist to add volume and shape to the Pallu fan. (e.g., pleated silver fan, gold fan)
Forehead decoration symbolizing the third eye. (e.g., round red bindi, decorative long bindi)
Red dye applied to palms and soles for ceremonial purposes. (e.g., liquid Alta in bottle, Alta bottle)
Worn on the head; Chandra on the left, Surya on the right. (e.g., Chandra (moon) + Surya (sun) ornaments)
Tightly fitted necklace at the base of the neck. (e.g., gold choker with stones, Bharatanatyam choker)
Long necklace worn over the choker, often pinned to the Pallu. (e.g., long gold necklace with pendant)

author: kritika.hora

name: How to Wear a Wig With Long Hair
summary: A step-by-step tutorial on how to tuck and hide long hair underneath a wig to ensure a secure and natural look. The method uses braids, a wig cap, and bobby pins to flatten the hair and prevent the wig from slipping.
author: Penolopy Bulnick

name: How to Weld - MIG Welding
summary: A beginner's guide to MIG (Metal Inert Gas) welding. It covers the basic operation of a MIG welder, safety precautions, preparation of materials, and techniques for laying a weld bead and joining metal pieces.

bom.notes: Основное устройство: подаёт напряжение и ток для создания дуги и подачи присадочной проволоки. (e.g., Hobart Handler 140, Lincoln Electric Weld Pak 140, Miller Millermatic 211)
Расходный присадочный материал: электрод, который плавится и заполняет шов. (e.g., Lincoln Electric L-50 0.023" 2 lb spool, Hobart 0.023" ER70S-6 2 lb spool)
Защищает сварочную ванну от кислорода и азота воздуха, предотвращая окисление и пористость. (e.g., C25 (75% Ar / 25% CO2) 20-80 cu ft cylinder, 100% CO2)
Защита глаз и лица от ультрафиолетового и инфракрасного излучения дуги. (e.g., Hobart 770880, Lincoln Viking 3350, Miller Big Window Elite)
Термостойкие перчатки для защиты рук от тепла и брызг расплавленного металла. (e.g., Tillman 850 TIG/Spot, Lincoln Electric K2981, Jackson Safety 59-3810)
Инструмент для зачистки кромок металла перед сваркой и шлифовки шва после. (e.g., DeWalt DWE402, Makita GA4530, Milwaukee 2780-20)
Фиксация деталей в нужном положении во время сварки для точного выдерживания зазора и прямого шва. (e.g., Strong Hand Tools Mitee Grip 30/60/90, Magnetic welding squares)

author: noahw

name: How to Weld Aluminum Without a Welder
summary: This project teaches a technique to join aluminum tubing using a propane torch and aluminum brazing rods, simulating welding without an actual welder. It's a low-cost method for repairing or fabricating aluminum structures in off-grid or limited-resource environments. The process involves cleaning, heating, and applying brazing rods to create a strong bond.

bom.notes: Main structural elements to be joined
Filler material that bonds the aluminum pieces at low temperature (e.g., Alumaloy, Super Alloy 1)
Heat source to melt brazing rod and preheat base aluminum (e.g., Bernzomatic ST2200T, Bernzomatic Premium Torch (yellow model))

author: Make Something TV

name: How to Weld - TIG Welding
summary: Пошаговое руководство по TIG-сварке для начинающих. Объясняет выбор электрода, настройки аппарата, подготовку металла и технику выполнения сварного шва.

bom.notes: Электрод для AC сварки алюминия (e.g., EWP (Pure Tungsten) 2.4mm x 150mm)
Электрод для DC сварки стали и нержавейки (e.g., EWTh-2 (2% торированный) 2.4mm x 150mm)
Присадочный материал для алюминиевых швов (e.g., ER4043 1.6mm x 300mm, ER5356 1.6mm)
Присадочный материал для стальных швов (e.g., ER70S-6 1.6mm x 300mm)
Держатель электрода в горелке (e.g., WP-9 collet body, WP-17 collet body)
Направляет поток защитного газа и защищает электрод (e.g., WP-9 Nozzle #5 (6.3mm), WP-17 Nozzle #10 (11mm))
Улучшает ламинарность потока газа, расширяет зону защиты (e.g., WP-9 gas lens, WP-17 gas lens)

author: stasterisk

name: How to Win a Chess Game in 2 Moves
